title: Purpose
description: Why everything below exists, stated once at the top of the strategy: the vision and mission every goal serves (Kaufman's ideal vision; the Balanced Scorecard's mission and vision). One per workspace, metadata.id always "default". Not an aim: a goal says what the organisation sets out to do, the purpose says what for. See TAXONOMY.md D24.

organisation.description: The organisation this is the purpose of, by the name its people use for it. Shown wherever the strategy speaks of the organisation ("the vision of ..."). See TAXONOMY.md D37.

vision.description: The future the organisation is working towards, as a state of the world it serves, not of itself.

mission.description: What the organisation does, and for whom, to get there.

source.description: Where the vision and mission are published, so a reader can check them: a plan and its section.

logo.description: The organisation's logo, as a data URL of a PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG image (at most about 300 KB), shown beside its name in the interface and on every charter's cover. Held in the record, not a file beside it, so it travels with the workspace on every store. See TAXONOMY.md D37.
